AppPreview.heading: See what you're stepping into
AppPreview.description: These are real screenshots from Parfect — no mockups. Tap through the screens couples use every day.

screenCaptions.home: Your partner's mood, this week's question, and what needs you next.
screenCaptions.chat: Photos, reactions, and fantasies moved into the conversation.
screenCaptions.fantasies: Ask, share, and keep talking — at your own pace.
screenCaptions.together-dates: The next date night, with time, place, and sitter.
screenCaptions.together-wishes: Wish for something. Your partner makes it happen.
screenCaptions.gallery: Every photo and video you've shared, with your favourites.
screenCaptions.relationship: Your connection score, mood calendar, and a look back.

alt.checkin-reveal: Parfect weekly check-in with both partners' answers side by side
alt.calendar: Parfect shared calendar with upcoming date nights
